name: The second plan

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Dashel says Plan A failed and identifies Slim’s Menethil lead.
description: Dashel Stonefist is not the author of the whole scheme. He admits that the first plan failed and points to a second one involving Tapoke “Slim” Jahn in Menethil Harbor. The clue sends the inquiry north, beyond the green woods and toward the Wetlands’ cold coast. A failed operation has left a loose end; the search follows it to the inn where Slim believes he can remain unnoticed.
